gizmo.title: Su'aal Kala-soocid
gizmo.description: U kala sooc walxaha siday u kala horreeyaan si sax ah.

configure.title: Jawaabaha
configure.description: Kala horraynta jawaabaha ayaa qeexaysa taxanaha saxda ah.

advanced.title: La isku laaban karo
advanced.description: U muuji su'aashan sidii saf furma oo xirma. Mid furiddiisa wuxuu xidhayaa su'aalaha kale ee la isku laaban karo ee ku dhow.

advanced.title: Ku bilow isku laaban
advanced.description: Marka la isku laaban karo, ku bilow saf xiran oo muujinaya su'aasha iyo xaaladeeda oo keliya.

advanced.title: Qaabka dhibcaha

advanced.title: Ujeeddada waxbarasho
advanced.description: OER Schema: ujeeddada waxbarasho ee la xiriirta qiimayntan.

developer.title: Magaca imtixaanka
developer.description: Magaca imtixaanka loo isticmaalo aqoonsiga xAPI ee nidaamyada falanqaynta.

developer.title: Koorso
